subject.title: feat(tui): opt-in persistence and agent visibility for `!`/`!!` local shell commands

question: Should TUI local-shell sharing use `!` for agent-visible persisted output and `!!` for persisted history-only output, behind per-session consent?
rationale: This adds a user-facing shell convention, sensitive-output consent policy, and hidden gateway mutation API; code repairs cannot decide whether those permanent semantics are desired.

options.title: Approve the proposed convention
options.body: Keep `!` agent-visible and `!!` history-only, but require session-scoped consent, correct replay, protocol review, and live proof before merge.

options.title: Persist history only
options.body: Allow optional session-history persistence but never place local shell output into model context automatically.

options.title: Keep commands local-only
options.body: Do not add transcript persistence or the new gateway RPC, preserving current behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve the proposed convention
recommendation.body: Keep `!` agent-visible and `!!` history-only, but require session-scoped consent, correct replay, protocol review, and live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily TUI product semantics and consent policy, and recent history shows direct ownership of local-shell and session-lifecycle surfaces.
